E2-2020-T3-P1-S7.trunk: 表语从句：That's because they put the costs on drivers rather than manufacturers（这是因为成本被强加给司机而非制造商）
structure: └ 表语从句(because)：they inevitably put the costs of cleaning the air on to individual drivers
├ 非限制性定语从句(who)：who must pay fees or buy better vehicles
└ 对比结构：rather than on to the car manufacturers
└ 定语从句(whose)：whose cheating is the real cause of our toxic pollution
E2-2020-T3-P1-S7.logic: because 解释措施为何脆弱；rather than 对比实际承担成本者与应负责任者，who 和 whose 分别补充两方信息。
notes: put the costs on to somebody：把成本转嫁给某人。
whose cheating：这些制造商的作弊行为。

E2-2020-T3-P1-S10.trunk: 条件复句：If Sadiq Khan wins and extends it..., it is sure to spark opposition（如果汗获胜并扩区，必将引发反对）
structure: 条件状语从句(if)：Sadiq Khan wins and extends it to ... roads in 2021
└ 方式状语从句(as)：as he intends
主句：it is sure to spark intense opposition
└ 介词短语：from the far larger number of motorists
└ 定语从句(who)：who will then be affected
E2-2020-T3-P1-S10.logic: if 给出扩区假设，as 插入说明这是既定意图；主句预测结果，who 解释反对者为何会反对。
notes: the far larger number of：数量大得多的……。

E2-2020-T3-P1-S18.trunk: S+系动词+表语：Restrictions ... are a response to the absence of a larger effort（限制措施是对更大行动缺失的回应）
structure: └ 定语从句(that)：that keep highly polluting cars out of certain areas
└ 破折号举例：city centres, school streets, even individual roads
系表结构：are a response to the absence of a larger effort
├ 不定式①：to properly enforce existing regulations
└ 并列不定式②：(to) require auto companies to bring their vehicles into compliance
E2-2020-T3-P1-S18.logic: that 界定限制措施内容；两个并列不定式说明缺失的全国性行动本应做什么。
notes: keep cars out of：禁止车辆进入。
absence of an effort：相关行动的缺失。
